mistake.vi-VN: Chơi để thắng mà quên điều kiện.

name.ja-JP: 砂上スプリント
name.th-TH: สปรินต์บนทราย

note.en:
Purpose: Fitness in the sand: every step costs more than it does on a court, so the legs are built and the landings are safe — and the first three steps are the whole game.
Frequency: Loaded into fitness days and the pre-season, when the base for the whole year is built.
Setup: two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time.
Equipment: the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane.
Sequence: Step 1: the player moves up the board to sprint flat out; Step 2: the player moves back to jog to recover.
How it continues: Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
Coaching point: Short steps and high knees — the sand takes the stride length away, so the speed has to come from turning the legs over faster.
note.en-GB:
Purpose: Fitness in the sand: every step costs more than it does on a court, so the legs are built and the landings are safe — and the first three steps are the whole game.
Frequency: Loaded into fitness days and the pre-season, when the base for the whole year is built.
Setup: two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time.
Equipment: the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane.
Sequence: Step 1: the player moves up the board to sprint flat out; Step 2: the player moves back to jog to recover.
How it continues: Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
Coaching point: Short steps and high knees — the sand takes the stride length away, so the speed has to come from turning the legs over faster.
note.zh-CN:
【目的】沙地体能：每一步都比硬地费力，练的是腿也是落地的安全——而这项运动拼的就是头三步。
【频度】安排在体能日和赛季初——为一整年打底子的时候。
【组织】球场一侧从底线到网前放两个锥标；全组一人一次轮流出发。
【器材】两个锥标是冲刺的两端：底线和网前；慢跑回来走场外，把跑道让给下一个人。
【流程】第1步：球员向前移动（全力冲刺）；第2步：球员向后移动（慢跑恢复）。
【连贯】沿场地长边冲刺一趟，30 秒内绕回来再出发；做 10 次后到阴凉处休息 3 分钟。
【要点】小步、高抬腿——沙子会把步幅吃掉，速度只能靠步频提上去。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】沙地體能：每一步都比硬地費力，練的是腿也是落地的安全——而這項運動拼的就是頭三步。
【頻度】安排在體能日和賽季初——為一整年打底子的時候。
【組織】球場一側從底線到網前放兩個錐標；全組一人一次輪流出發。
【器材】兩個錐標是衝刺的兩端：底線和網前；慢跑回來走場外，把跑道讓給下一個人。
【流程】第1步：球員向前移動（全力衝刺）；第2步：球員向後移動（慢跑恢復）。
【連貫】沿場地長邊衝刺一趟，30 秒內繞回來再出發；做 10 次後到陰涼處休息 3 分鐘。
【要點】小步、高抬腿——沙子會把步幅吃掉，速度只能靠步頻提上去。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】砂上のフィジカル：一歩がコートより重く、脚も着地の安全も鍛えられる——そしてこの競技は最初の3歩で決まる。
【頻度】フィットネス日とプレシーズンに組み込む。一年の土台を作る時期。
【準備】two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time。
【用具】the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane。
【流れ】ステップ1：選手が前方へ移動し、全力でダッシュ。ステップ2：選手が後方へ移動し、ジョグで回復。
【続け方】Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
【ポイント】歩幅は小さく、膝は高く——砂はストライドを奪うので、速さは回転の速さで出すしかない。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】모래에서의 체력: 한 걸음이 코트보다 무겁다. 다리도 착지의 안전도 함께 만들어지며, 이 종목은 첫 세 걸음이 전부다.
【빈도】체력 훈련일과 프리시즌에 배치 — 한 해 전체의 기초를 쌓는 시기.
【준비】two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time.
【장비】the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane.
【진행】1단계: 선수는 앞으로 이동해 전력 질주; 2단계: 선수는 뒤로 이동해 조깅으로 회복.
【이어가기】Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
【포인트】보폭은 짧게, 무릎은 높게 — 모래가 보폭을 먹어버리니 속도는 회전수로 내야 한다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Físico en la arena: cada paso cuesta más que en pista, así que se construyen las piernas y se aseguran las caídas; y en este deporte todo son los tres primeros pasos.
Frecuencia: Se programa en los días de físico y la pretemporada, cuando se construye la base del año.
Montaje: two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time.
Material: the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane.
Secuencia: Paso 1: el jugador se desplaza hacia delante para esprintar a tope; Paso 2: el jugador se desplaza hacia atrás para trotar para recuperar.
Continuidad: Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
Punto clave: Pasos cortos y rodillas altas: la arena se lleva la zancada, así que la velocidad sale de mover las piernas más rápido.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Physique sur le sable : chaque appui coûte plus que sur un terrain dur, on construit les jambes et on sécurise les réceptions — et tout se joue sur les trois premiers pas.
Fréquence : Placé lors des journées physiques et de la présaison, quand se construit la base de l'année.
Mise en place : two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time.
Matériel : the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane.
Déroulé : Étape 1 : le joueur se déplace vers l'avant pour sprinter à fond ; Étape 2 : le joueur se déplace vers l'arrière pour trottiner pour récupérer.
Enchaînement : Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
Point clé : Petites foulées, genoux hauts : le sable mange l'amplitude, la vitesse vient donc de la fréquence.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Fisik di pasir: setiap langkah lebih berat daripada di lapangan keras, kaki terbentuk dan pendaratan jadi aman.
Frekuensi: Ditempatkan di hari kebugaran dan pramusim, saat fondasi setahun dibangun.
Persiapan: two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time.
Perlengkapan: the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane.
Urutan: Langkah 1: pemain bergerak ke depan untuk lari sekencang mungkin; Langkah 2: pemain bergerak ke belakang untuk joging untuk pulih.
Kelanjutan: Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
Poin utama: Langkah pendek dan lutut tinggi — pasir memakan panjang langkah, jadi kecepatan datang dari frekuensi.
note.ms-MY:
Tujuan: Fizikal di pasir: setiap langkah lebih berat daripada di gelanggang keras, kaki terbentuk dan pendaratan jadi selamat.
Kekerapan: Diletakkan pada hari kecergasan dan pramusim, ketika asas setahun dibina.
Persediaan: two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time.
Peralatan: the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane.
Urutan: Langkah 1: pemain bergerak ke hadapan untuk pecut sepenuh tenaga; Langkah 2: pemain bergerak ke belakang untuk berjoging untuk pulih.
Kesinambungan: Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
Poin utama: Langkah pendek dan lutut tinggi — pasir memakan panjang langkah, jadi kelajuan datang dari kekerapan.
note.th-TH:
จุดประสงค์: ฟิตเนสบนทราย: ทุกก้าวหนักกว่าบนคอร์ต สร้างขาและลงพื้นอย่างปลอดภัย และกีฬานี้วัดกันที่สามก้าวแรก
ความถี่: จัดในวันฟิตเนสและช่วงพรีซีซัน ตอนที่สร้างพื้นฐานของทั้งปี
การจัด: two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time
อุปกรณ์: the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane
ลำดับ: ขั้นที่ 1: ผู้เล่น ขยับไปข้างหน้าเพื่อวิ่งสุดแรง • ขั้นที่ 2: ผู้เล่น ขยับถอยหลังเพื่อวิ่งเหยาะเพื่อฟื้นตัว
การต่อเนื่อง: Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
จุดเน้น: ก้าวสั้นและยกเข่าสูง ทรายกินความยาวก้าว ความเร็วจึงต้องมาจากความถี่
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Thể lực trên cát: mỗi bước nặng hơn trên sân cứng, vừa xây chân vừa an toàn khi tiếp đất — và môn này quyết ở ba bước đầu.
Tần suất: Xếp vào ngày thể lực và tiền mùa giải, khi xây nền cho cả năm.
Bố trí: two cones from the baseline to the net on one side of the court; the group goes one at a time.
Dụng cụ: the two cones are the ends of the sprint — the baseline and the net; the jog back is outside the court so the next runner has the lane.
Trình tự: Bước 1: cầu thủ di chuyển lên phía trước để chạy nước rút hết sức; Bước 2: cầu thủ di chuyển lùi lại để chạy chậm để hồi phục.
Tiếp nối: Sprint the length, jog round and go again inside 30 seconds; ten sprints, then three minutes in the shade.
Điểm chính: Bước ngắn và nâng cao gối — cát lấy mất sải chân, tốc độ phải đến từ tần số.

mistake.en: Pacing the hard reps to survive the set — a rep held back is a rep that did not count.
mistake.en-GB: Pacing the hard reps to survive the set — a rep held back is a rep that did not count.

name.ja-JP: 連続ジャンプ
name.th-TH: ชุดกระโดด

note.en:
Purpose: Fitness in the sand: every step costs more than it does on a court, so the legs are built and the landings are safe — and the first three steps are the whole game.
Frequency: Loaded into fitness days and the pre-season, when the base for the whole year is built.
Setup: the player two steps behind the net, the sand raked flat, nobody in front.
Equipment: the shaded zone is where the jump starts and lands: footvolley lands on the back and the shoulders as often as on the feet, so the zone has to be clear of everybody.
Sequence: Step 1: the player moves up the board to take off and land on both feet; Step 2: the player gets back to the cone; Step 3: the player moves up the board to take off and land on both feet; Step 4: the player gets back to the cone.
How it continues: Six bicycle-kick take-offs with the full action, two minutes' rest; three sets. Land on the shoulder and roll, never on a straight arm.
Coaching point: Reach the same height on the last jump as on the first; the moment the height drops the set is over, however many are left — height is the quality being trained.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】沙地体能：每一步都比硬地费力，练的是腿也是落地的安全——而这项运动拼的就是头三步。
【频度】安排在体能日和赛季初——为一整年打底子的时候。
【组织】球员站在网后两步，脚下的沙耙平，前方无人。
【器材】阴影区是起跳和落地的区域：足排球经常是背部和肩部着地，所以这个区域里不能有别人。
【流程】第1步：球员向前移动（起跳，双脚落地）；第2步：球员回到原位；第3步：球员向前移动（起跳，双脚落地）；第4步：球员回到原位。
【连贯】带完整倒钩动作的起跳做 6 次，休息 2 分钟；做 3 组。落地用肩着地顺势滚开，绝不能用直臂撑地。
【要点】最后一跳要和第一跳一样高；高度一掉就停，不管还剩几个——练的就是高度。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】沙地體能：每一步都比硬地費力，練的是腿也是落地的安全——而這項運動拼的就是頭三步。
【頻度】安排在體能日和賽季初——為一整年打底子的時候。
【組織】球員站在網後兩步，腳下的沙耙平，前方無人。
【器材】陰影區是起跳和落地的區域：足排球經常是背部和肩部著地，所以這個區域裡不能有別人。
【流程】第1步：球員向前移動（起跳，雙腳落地）；第2步：球員回到原位；第3步：球員向前移動（起跳，雙腳落地）；第4步：球員回到原位。
【連貫】帶完整倒鉤動作的起跳做 6 次，休息 2 分鐘；做 3 組。落地用肩著地順勢滾開，絕不能用直臂撐地。
【要點】最後一跳要和第一跳一樣高；高度一掉就停，不管還剩幾個——練的就是高度。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】砂上のフィジカル：一歩がコートより重く、脚も着地の安全も鍛えられる——そしてこの競技は最初の3歩で決まる。
【頻度】フィットネス日とプレシーズンに組み込む。一年の土台を作る時期。
【準備】the player two steps behind the net, the sand raked flat, nobody in front。
【用具】the shaded zone is where the jump starts and lands: footvolley lands on the back and the shoulders as often as on the feet, so the zone has to be clear of everybody。
【流れ】ステップ1：選手が前方へ移動し、踏み切って両足で着地。ステップ2：選手が元の位置に戻る。ステップ3：選手が前方へ移動し、踏み切って両足で着地。ステップ4：選手が元の位置に戻る。
【続け方】Six bicycle-kick take-offs with the full action, two minutes' rest; three sets. Land on the shoulder and roll, never on a straight arm.
【ポイント】最後の1本も1本目と同じ高さまで跳ぶ。高さが落ちた時点で、残りが何本でもそのセットは終わり——鍛えているのは高さだ。

【진행】1단계: 선수는 앞으로 이동해 도약해 두 발로 착지; 2단계: 선수는 원래 자리로 돌아간다; 3단계: 선수는 앞으로 이동해 도약해 두 발로 착지; 4단계: 선수는 원래 자리로 돌아간다.
【이어가기】Six bicycle-kick take-offs with the full action, two minutes' rest; three sets. Land on the shoulder and roll, never on a straight arm.
【포인트】마지막 점프도 첫 점프와 같은 높이로. 높이가 떨어지는 순간 몇 개가 남았든 세트는 끝이다 — 훈련하는 것은 높이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Físico en la arena: cada paso cuesta más que en pista, así que se construyen las piernas y se aseguran las caídas; y en este deporte todo son los tres primeros pasos.
Frecuencia: Se programa en los días de físico y la pretemporada, cuando se construye la base del año.
Montaje: the player two steps behind the net, the sand raked flat, nobody in front.
Material: the shaded zone is where the jump starts and lands: footvolley lands on the back and the shoulders as often as on the feet, so the zone has to be clear of everybody.
Secuencia: Paso 1: el jugador se desplaza hacia delante para saltar y caer con los dos pies; Paso 2: el jugador vuelve a su cono; Paso 3: el jugador se desplaza hacia delante para saltar y caer con los dos pies; Paso 4: el jugador vuelve a su cono.
Continuidad: Six bicycle-kick take-offs with the full action, two minutes' rest; three sets. Land on the shoulder and roll, never on a straight arm.
Punto clave: Alcanza la misma altura en el último salto que en el primero; en cuanto baja la altura, la serie se acaba, queden los que queden: lo que se entrena es la altura.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Physique sur le sable : chaque appui coûte plus que sur un terrain dur, on construit les jambes et on sécurise les réceptions — et tout se joue sur les trois premiers pas.
Fréquence : Placé lors des journées physiques et de la présaison, quand se construit la base de l'année.
Mise en place : the player two steps behind the net, the sand raked flat, nobody in front.
Matériel : the shaded zone is where the jump starts and lands: footvolley lands on the back and the shoulders as often as on the feet, so the zone has to be clear of everybody.
Déroulé : Étape 1 : le joueur se déplace vers l'avant pour sauter et retomber sur deux pieds ; Étape 2 : le joueur revient sur son plot ; Étape 3 : le joueur se déplace vers l'avant pour sauter et retomber sur deux pieds ; Étape 4 : le joueur revient sur son plot.
Enchaînement : Six bicycle-kick take-offs with the full action, two minutes' rest; three sets. Land on the shoulder and roll, never on a straight arm.
Point clé : Atteins la même hauteur au dernier saut qu'au premier ; dès que la hauteur baisse, la série est finie, quel qu'en soit le reste — c'est la hauteur que l'on travaille.

Persiapan: the player two steps behind the net, the sand raked flat, nobody in front.

Urutan: Langkah 1: pemain bergerak ke depan untuk melompat dan mendarat dua kaki; Langkah 2: pemain kembali ke cone; Langkah 3: pemain bergerak ke depan untuk melompat dan mendarat dua kaki; Langkah 4: pemain kembali ke cone.
Kelanjutan: Six bicycle-kick take-offs with the full action, two minutes' rest; three sets. Land on the shoulder and roll, never on a straight arm.
Poin utama: Capai tinggi yang sama pada lompatan terakhir seperti yang pertama; begitu tingginya turun, set selesai.

name.ja-JP: サイドステップ
name.th-TH: สไลด์ข้าง

note.en:
Purpose: Fitness in the sand: every step costs more than it does on a court, so the legs are built and the landings are safe — and the first three steps are the whole game.
Frequency: Loaded into fitness days and the pre-season, when the base for the whole year is built.
Setup: three cones across the middle of the half; the player starts on the middle one.
Equipment: three cones 4 m apart are the width two players have to cover between them: shuffle to each and back, and every arrival is a chest or thigh control, not a look.
Sequence: Step 1: the player moves left to side-shuffle without crossing the feet; Step 2: the player moves right to side-shuffle without crossing the feet; Step 3: the player moves right to side-shuffle without crossing the feet; Step 4: the player moves left to side-shuffle without crossing the feet.
How it continues: Twenty seconds side to side, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, then the pair swaps.
Coaching point: Feet never cross and the head never bobs: stay low the whole way, and the last step out is as wide as the first.

note.ko-KR:
【목적】모래에서의 체력: 한 걸음이 코트보다 무겁다. 다리도 착지의 안전도 함께 만들어지며, 이 종목은 첫 세 걸음이 전부다.
【빈도】체력 훈련일과 프리시즌에 배치 — 한 해 전체의 기초를 쌓는 시기.
【준비】three cones across the middle of the half; the player starts on the middle one.
【장비】three cones 4 m apart are the width two players have to cover between them: shuffle to each and back, and every arrival is a chest or thigh control, not a look.
【진행】1단계: 선수는 왼쪽으로 이동해 발을 교차하지 않고 사이드 스텝; 2단계: 선수는 오른쪽으로 이동해 발을 교차하지 않고 사이드 스텝; 3단계: 선수는 오른쪽으로 이동해 발을 교차하지 않고 사이드 스텝; 4단계: 선수는 왼쪽으로 이동해 발을 교차하지 않고 사이드 스텝.
【이어가기】Twenty seconds side to side, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, then the pair swaps.
【포인트】발은 교차하지 않고 머리는 위아래로 흔들리지 않는다: 끝까지 낮게, 마지막 한 걸음도 첫 걸음만큼 넓게.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Físico en la arena: cada paso cuesta más que en pista, así que se construyen las piernas y se aseguran las caídas; y en este deporte todo son los tres primeros pasos.
Frecuencia: Se programa en los días de físico y la pretemporada, cuando se construye la base del año.
Montaje: three cones across the middle of the half; the player starts on the middle one.
Material: three cones 4 m apart are the width two players have to cover between them: shuffle to each and back, and every arrival is a chest or thigh control, not a look.
Secuencia: Paso 1: el jugador se desplaza a la izquierda para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies; Paso 2: el jugador se desplaza a la derecha para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies; Paso 3: el jugador se desplaza a la derecha para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies; Paso 4: el jugador se desplaza a la izquierda para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies.
Continuidad: Twenty seconds side to side, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, then the pair swaps.
Punto clave: Los pies no se cruzan y la cabeza no sube y baja: mantente bajo todo el rato y el último paso es tan amplio como el primero.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Physique sur le sable : chaque appui coûte plus que sur un terrain dur, on construit les jambes et on sécurise les réceptions — et tout se joue sur les trois premiers pas.
Fréquence : Placé lors des journées physiques et de la présaison, quand se construit la base de l'année.
Mise en place : three cones across the middle of the half; the player starts on the middle one.
Matériel : three cones 4 m apart are the width two players have to cover between them: shuffle to each and back, and every arrival is a chest or thigh control, not a look.
Déroulé : Étape 1 : le joueur se déplace à gauche pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds ; Étape 2 : le joueur se déplace à droite pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds ; Étape 3 : le joueur se déplace à droite pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds ; Étape 4 : le joueur se déplace à gauche pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds.
Enchaînement : Twenty seconds side to side, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, then the pair swaps.
Point clé : Les pieds ne se croisent pas et la tête ne monte pas : reste bas jusqu'au bout, le dernier appui aussi large que le premier.
note.id-ID:
Tujuan: Fisik di pasir: setiap langkah lebih berat daripada di lapangan keras, kaki terbentuk dan pendaratan jadi aman.
Frekuensi: Ditempatkan di hari kebugaran dan pramusim, saat fondasi setahun dibangun.
Persiapan: three cones across the middle of the half; the player starts on the middle one.
Perlengkapan: three cones 4 m apart are the width two players have to cover between them: shuffle to each and back, and every arrival is a chest or thigh control, not a look.
Urutan: Langkah 1: pemain bergerak ke kiri untuk geser menyamping tanpa menyilangkan kaki; Langkah 2: pemain bergerak ke kanan untuk geser menyamping tanpa menyilangkan kaki; Langkah 3: pemain bergerak ke kanan untuk geser menyamping tanpa menyilangkan kaki; Langkah 4: pemain bergerak ke kiri untuk geser menyamping tanpa menyilangkan kaki.
Kelanjutan: Twenty seconds side to side, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, then the pair swaps.
Poin utama: Kaki tidak menyilang dan kepala tidak naik-turun: tetap rendah sampai akhir, langkah terakhir selebar yang pertama.
note.ms-MY:

note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Thể lực trên cát: mỗi bước nặng hơn trên sân cứng, vừa xây chân vừa an toàn khi tiếp đất — và môn này quyết ở ba bước đầu.
Tần suất: Xếp vào ngày thể lực và tiền mùa giải, khi xây nền cho cả năm.
Bố trí: three cones across the middle of the half; the player starts on the middle one.
Dụng cụ: three cones 4 m apart are the width two players have to cover between them: shuffle to each and back, and every arrival is a chest or thigh control, not a look.
Trình tự: Bước 1: cầu thủ di chuyển sang trái để trượt ngang không bắt chéo chân; Bước 2: cầu thủ di chuyển sang phải để trượt ngang không bắt chéo chân; Bước 3: cầu thủ di chuyển sang phải để trượt ngang không bắt chéo chân; Bước 4: cầu thủ di chuyển sang trái để trượt ngang không bắt chéo chân.
Tiếp nối: Twenty seconds side to side, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, then the pair swaps.
Điểm chính: Chân không bắt chéo, đầu không nhấp nhô: giữ thấp suốt, bước cuối rộng như bước đầu.

mistake.en: Pacing the hard reps to survive the set — a rep held back is a rep that did not count.
mistake.en-GB: Pacing the hard reps to survive the set — a rep held back is a rep that did not count.
mistake.zh-CN: 为了撑完一组而在快的那趟留力——留了力的那趟等于没跑。
mistake.zh-TW: 為了撐完一組而在快的那趟留力——留了力的那趟等於沒跑。
mistake.ja-JP: セットを乗り切るためにきつい本数で力を残す——残した1本はカウントされない。
mistake.ko-KR: 세트를 버티려고 힘든 회차에서 힘을 아낀다 — 아낀 회차는 하지 않은 것과 같다.
mistake.es-ES: Dosificar las repeticiones duras para aguantar la serie: la que te guardas no cuenta.
mistake.fr-FR: Se ménager sur les répétitions dures pour tenir la série — celle où l'on se retient ne compte pas.
mistake.id-ID: Menahan tenaga di ulangan berat demi bertahan satu set.
mistake.ms-MY: Menahan tenaga pada ulangan berat demi bertahan satu set.
mistake.th-TH: ออมแรงในรอบหนักเพื่อให้จบเซ็ต รอบที่ออมแรงเท่ากับไม่ได้ทำ
mistake.vi-VN: Giữ sức ở những lượt nặng để trụ hết hiệp — lượt giữ sức coi như không tính.
